sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 3)

purpose.zh: 练肩前侧和手腕，是团身俄挺前的一级
purpose.en: Trains the front of your shoulders and wrists; the step before the tuck planche.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩膀往前移过手腕
text.en: Arms locked, shift your shoulders past your wrists

text.zh: 脚尖推地往前送，倾到能控住的位置就停。
text.en: Push off your toes to lean forward, stop where you can still control it.

text.zh: 肩胛骨一直推开，身体从头到脚一条线。
text.en: Keep pushing the floor away, body in one line head to heels.

commonErrors.en: Sagging your lower back or piking your hips.

commonErrors.zh: 肩胛骨夹紧，没把地面推开
commonErrors.en: Squeezing your shoulder blades instead of pushing the floor away.

cautions.zh: 手腕吃不住就少往前倾一点，从手前 5 厘米开始
cautions.en: If your wrists can't take it, lean less and start about 5 cm forward.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面（清楚显示肩超过手腕多少）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
